answer.rationale: With the line at 94% committed volume and the contract expiring in 14 days, changing primary supply or deferring creates disproportionate continuity risk. Retaining the incumbent while negotiating benchmarked pricing, payment terms, and a volume-backed multi-year structure is the most plausible single action to pursue the 18% spend reduction without introducing migration or delivery risk. Verify the prior renegotiation and multi-year pricing records before committing to targets and term length.
